## 1.3.0 (2026-05-03)


### Features

* add API diagnostics and /data graph fallback to results screen
* make results activity API-first for saved remote sessions
* polish results screen layout and dynamic graph zoom behavior
* port balance statokinesigram fallback to Android results
* redesign results screen for user-first flow and graph viewport controls


### Bug Fixes

* align results graph placeholder view type with layout
* refine results avatar placeholder and graph zoom behavior
* remove orphaned password screen view reference and other buttons padronization
* standardize app dialogs and reconcile deleted remote patients
* support camelCase capture data fields in results graph fallback
